description: BRaVDA assimilates observations into a solar-wind propagation model through a variational procedure. It provides a way to adjust the propagated solar-wind state using measurements, not relying only on an uncorrected background model. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The page offers a software deposit link, but installation and numerical performance were not tested. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
